about_short_description.short_description: Chariot is a revolutionizing moving company operations with easy-to-use software.

product.name: Sales CRM
product.description: A CRM system designed for moving companies to manage customer intake, generate estimates, and track potential customers efficiently.

product.name: Digital Bills of Lading (BoLs)
product.description: A digital tool for creating, managing, and sending compliant bills of lading to customers, replacing paper forms and reducing errors.

product.name: Estimates
product.description: A feature that automatically calculates crew size and hours needed, builds detailed move estimates, and sends professional quotes to customers.

product.name: Office Calendar
product.description: A scheduling tool to manage surveys, jobs, and office events with real-time capacity tracking and team visibility.

product.name: Web (New Lead) Form
product.description: An embeddable web form that captures moving leads with detailed customer and inventory information, integrating directly into Chariot.

product.name: Movers / Drivers App
product.description: A mobile-accessible tool for movers and drivers to receive job assignments, track time, take photos, collect signatures, and process payments.
